12% of remote listings now ask for AI skills — and it's not just engineering roles.

From 3,928 active remote listings, 487 explicitly require AI. That's 12% of the board. AI demand now sits ahead of leadership (11%) and sales (9%), trailing only communication (41%) in frequency.

What the numbers say:
- Highest disclosed pay is USD 132,400-238,400/yr at Jabil for a Sr. Principal Product Engineer.
- Only 22% of listings disclose pay at all — 78% hide salary, so negotiate on market data.
- AI appears across non-technical roles too: People Ops (Sardine), BDR (Creator), Insurance Agent (HSS Careers), even Live Ops Manager (Devoted Studios).

The contrarian note: an AI title doesn't guarantee a premium. Communication (41%) and domain expertise still matter most.

If you're applying to remote USD jobs, add a dedicated AI Skills section, link a public demo, and mention concrete AI outcomes in your cover letter.
